title: Dominic and the Bakery
author: Cyrus Zhou
blurb: Tamsin Okonkwo, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
